column1: # The Scriptures - per-image content review (the content rule in CONTRIBUTING.md).
# Every image was looked at one by one: each master, page scans cropped toward the plate, details zoomed where noted.
# Rule: no nudity, no gore shown for shock; fully clothed people of any age are fine; when unsure, it is left out.
# A loincloth or a cloth from the waist (as on the cross) is recorded as covered. Bare breasts, buttocks, genitals, or an unclothed child are nudity.
# The build refuses any work without a row here and publishes only ADMIT.
